fields.System.Title: TRF-301 — Receive against a dispatch
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk at the destination, I want to book in a transfer against what the
origin sent, so that the stock becomes usable at this site.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a dispatched transfer, when I scan the packed units and confirm, then stock
  • moves from VIRT-INTRANSIT into a receiving location at the destination — in one transaction.
  • - Given the same receipt confirmed twice with one idempotency key, then stock is
  • received once — enforced by a unique constraint on dispatch reference plus line.
  • - Given a transfer already fully received, then a further receipt is rejected.
  • - Given confirmation, then transfers.transfer_received is published.
  • - Given the receipt, then batch and expiry data travel with the stock rather than being
  • re-entered.
  • - Given the transaction fails, then nothing changed and the stock stays in transit.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory |
| Tables | transfer_receipt, stock_balance, stock_movement, outbox |
| Risks | Transfer received twice creates stock from nothing ([doc 09 §9.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency (sequential and concurrent) · rollback · invariant |
